notes: S/(x_i^2, l1^2, l2^2) side proved for all n and E/(f,g) for even n by Boij-Lundqvist (arXiv:2608.22823, Thm 5.5, Cor 5.6, via CLN Thm 1). Odd n open (CLN: verified n <= 19, upper bound, first floor(n/3)+1 coefficients). Reduction recorded: odd n holds iff the homology of a generic linear form on the generic even algebra E_{n+1}/(F,G) has dimensions a(n,s+1)+a(n,s)-a(n+1,s+1). Outside Lean: everything.
